scope: Additive spectralnorm candidates only; no full timing admission.

runtime.provenance: Official Uiua ARM64 macOS release binary; not a locally compiled substitute.
runtime.system_library_policy: macOS platform libraries are supplied by the recorded host OS; no additional non-system runtime dylib is linked by Uiua.

programs.provenance: Locally authored additive Uiua vectorization; original frozen sources and measurements preserved.
adaptations: Primitive outer addition creates each index-sum array; ordinary pervasive arithmetic computes every coefficient on demand. Optimized form uses at most 128 output rows.

algorithm.reason: Every one of all 40 matrix-vector products recomputes all N squared coefficients, using native general-purpose Uiua outer addition and pervasive array arithmetic. No coefficient or triangular matrix is cached. Ascending input-order sums and complete partial blocks are retained.
algorithm.full_work: 20 A products + 20 A-transpose products; 40*N*N coefficient evaluations.

programs.loc_review: Each independent binding/data declaration is a separate nonblank noncomment line. Ordinary tacit pipelines remain one expression; no source packing discount.
